messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected: increased p95 latency on inference-gateway-prod pool (region-us-west). Pager triggered for oncall SRE. Impact: 25% of requests > 800ms. Auto-scaling healthy.
Danielle: ack. I'm on it, pulling logs.
Danielle: quick check — is there any deploy in last 30m? @Kevin can you confirm?
Kevin: no deploys in last 2h from ci/cd. saw a spike in redis errors earlier but it recovered. linking logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/tx/abc123 :eyes:
Danielle: grabbing live tail.
runbook-bot: Recommended first steps: 1) Identify slow route(s) via /metrics?route 2) Check kvcache evictions 3) If >70% tail latency, failover to variant-b with lower memory pressure.
Danielle: ran metrics query: /metrics?route=/v1/generate — p95 is 820ms, p50 160ms. errors increased 0.3% -> 1.1%.
Danielle: kv cache eviction spikes at 14:32 UTC, correlated with request surge. evict count: 183k in 5m.
Jess: I'm pulling pool node health. seeing 2 nodes with high CPU (93% and 95%), both on instance-type g5-16x. NVidia memory ok.
Danielle: mitigation plan: 1) increase pool target by +2 nodes (scales fast) 2) enable temporary routing to inference-variant-b (quantized) for non-critical traffic 3) create post-incident thread for follow-up.
Danielle: executing scale command now:
```
redwoodctl pools scale --name inference-gateway-prod --delta 2
```
incident-bot: RUNBOOK ACTION: scaled inference-gateway-prod +2 nodes (action id: run-7834). Auto-scaler still watching.
Kevin: routing rule for fallback ready. I'll flip a canary 20% to variant-b for 5m and watch errors.
Kevin: flipped canary at 14:40 UTC -> 20% traffic to variant-b.
Danielle: within 2min p95 dropped to 420ms for the canary cohort, overall p95 fell to 560ms.
Jess: CPU on the two hot nodes trending down after scale. tail latency improving.
Danielle: tracking immediate customer impact: estimated affected sessions ~ 3.2k over 20m window. No customer-reported errors yet.
Oliver (PM): thanks team — flag for postmortem: need clarity on kvcache sizing and autoscaler thresholds. Also want customer impact summary and remediation timeline for stakeholders.
Danielle: agreed. creating post-incident doc and scheduling review. Proposed times: today 16:00 UTC or tomorrow 10:00 UTC. @Oliver (PM) what works?
Oliver (PM): today 16:00 UTC works for me.
Danielle: created postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-1718609999. Adding attendees and action items.
Danielle: action items (initial) — listing owner + size estimate (S/M/L) + priority (P0,P1):
- AI-1: Validate kv cache eviction thresholds and add metric alerts -> owner: Jess -> size: M -> priority: P0 -> relate to Q2-cost-optim
- AI-2: Add fallback routing playbook with clear canary steps and rollback criteria -> owner: Kevin -> size: S -> priority: P1 -> relate to sprint-infra-42
- AI-3: Add per-route p95 alerting (synthetic + real traffic) and tie to paging thresholds -> owner: Danielle -> size: M -> priority: P0 -> relate to oncall-improve
- AI-4: Runload test to reproduce burst eviction pattern and evaluate larger cache config -> owner: SRE team (assign) -> size: L -> priority: P1 -> relate to Q3-capacity
- AI-5: Customer-facing summary for account teams (include impact numbers + mitigation) -> owner: Oliver (PM) -> size: S -> priority: P0 -> relate to comms-ops
Kevin: added estimate: AI-2 done in 2-3h. I'll draft playbook after handoff.
Jess: AI-1: I'll check current eviction thresholds and submit a PR for alert adjustments. size M is accurate.
Danielle: scheduling follow-up: created calendar invite for postmortem review today 16:00 UTC -> meeting link added. agenda: timeline, root cause hypotheses, action item assignment & sizing, owner commitments.
Danielle: for prioritization guidance: any AI marked P0 should be included in next sprint triage and slotted into dedicated capacity for this quarter. P1 items go into backlog grooming for Q3 consideration.
Oliver (PM): agree. Let's tag AI-1 and AI-3 for sprint start next week. I'll put them on my board and coordinate with engineering leads.
Danielle: I'll update the incident ticket with final impact numbers and link to postmortem doc. incident closed for oncall at 15:25 UTC but follow-ups remain.
incident-bot: INCIDENT status -> mitigated. Final snapshot: p95 peak 980ms at 14:33 UTC, baseline p95 after mitigation 150ms. Incident severity set to Sev2 (customer-impacting but no data loss).
Danielle: thanks all. please add any missing owners here or in the postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
Oliver (PM): will follow up with account team with the customer summary after review. tagging @support for heads-up.
Jess: will begin PR for alert tuning today, aim to have change by EOD.
Kevin: will post the fallback playbook draft to the runbooks repo and link in the postmortem.
Danielle: closing thread from oncall perspective. moving postmortem discussion to the doc/meeting."
